description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for STM32F4xx HAL Flash Extension operations, including erase, option bytes programming, and protection configurations.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Performs flash memory sector or mass erase based on provided parameters.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Performs flash memory sector or mass erase in interrupt mode.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Programs the option bytes with specified configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBProgram
methods.description: Programs advanced option bytes for extended features.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current extended option byte configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_SelectPCROP
methods.description: Enables Proprietary Code Read Out Protection.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_DeSelectPCROP
methods.description: Disables Proprietary Code Read Out Protection.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_GetBank2WRP
methods.description: Gets write protection status for bank 2 sectors.
